notes: Variant unit WLC.1CH.25.1.v001 selected r00-base, which is compatible and covers s017 and s018; no fallback question arises.
The chain `שָׂרֵי הַצָּבָא` is read by rule 29's arthrous count (a *the* before each English noun), not as a fronting.

`לִ` → *certain of*: the competing reading, leaving *certain of* one `added` unit under rule 15's partitive paragraph, was considered and set aside, because that paragraph marks the expression `added` only where no morpheme in the clause licenses it, and this `לְ` is the very morpheme the ASV renders *of* in the parallel entries at verses 2, 3 and 4. Head on *of*, which realizes the preposition's own relation (rule 24); heading on *certain*, as rule 19 heads a partitive `מִן` → *any of* on *any*, remains the competing reading.

`יַּבְדֵּל` → *set apart* heads on *set*: *apart* is a phrasal particle of the class rule 44 rules on in `סוּר` → *take away* and `נָתַן` → *put away*, and it is not a supplied particle, since the separating is written in the clause.

`אַנְשֵׁי מְלָאכָה` → *that did the work* is read by rule 46's closing paragraph as in rule 43's `בַּעַל כְּנָפַיִם` → *that which hath wings*: the relative and the recasting's verb belong to the construct noun, headed on *did*, while `מְלָאכָה` keeps *the work*.
